audit.description: Changed production code in pdpyras.py imports the real target API with `from httpx import Client, Response`, aliases the historical Session name to `Client`, subclasses `Client`, and routes requests through the httpx client request path. Static and dynamic anti-cheat evidence show no production repository imports or dynamic use of `requests`; the only recorded requests import came from external test/dependency context, not changed production code. The target provider is not faked because dynamic evidence resolves httpx to site-packages and reports zero local target specs.
evidence: pdpyras.py diff replaces `from requests import Response, Session` with `from httpx import Client, Response` and sets `Session = Client`.
pdpyras.py diff changes `class PDSession(Session)` to `class PDSession(Client)` and calls `self.parent.request(...)` through the httpx-backed parent client.
requirements.txt and setup.py replace requests/urllib3 dependencies with httpx.
Static anti-cheat: pdpyras.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, dynamic_imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false.
Dynamic anti-cheat: target_import from pdpyras.py line 17 resolves to site-packages/httpx/__init__.py; target_local_spec_count=0.
Dynamic anti-cheat: source_imports_from_production_repo_count=0 and source_imports_from_repo_count=0; only source_import_attempt is from external test_pdpyras.py under_repo=false.
reasons: Production code meaningfully uses httpx Client/Response and request calls.
No changed production file imports or dynamically accesses requests.
No local httpx shim/provider was added or used.

+    """Return a plain dict with the header names used by the public API."""
+    normalized = {}
+    for key, value in dict(headers).items():
+        lowered = key.lower()
+        if lowered == 'accept':
+            normalized['Accept'] = value
+        elif lowered == 'authorization':
